notes: Rig instrumentation (RigWatch) of the JOIDES Resolution during IODP Expedition 399. Files on the Zenodo record: 399_SITE_LOCATIONS.HTML, OPSRIG-README.txt and data_by_expedition.zip (229.0 MB). The licence covers the whole record. Open Well Data publishes a standardized copy of this record (recipe iodp-rigwatch); the standardization is CC BY-NC 4.0 and the original stays CC BY 4.0. Other expeditions are separate Zenodo records, each with its own licence. Related publication on the record: doi 10.14379/iodp.proc.399.2025.
